purpose: Acceptance policy for research A/B experiments on trainer and renderer quality. Governs what makes a change believable, not what makes a build shippable.

relationship_to_release_gate.rule: This contract never substitutes for the release contract and is never accepted where a reference-config is expected. reference-config.json and easysplat_benchmark.py APPROVED_THRESHOLDS remain frozen; nothing in this file authorizes editing them.
relationship_to_release_gate.conflict_rule: A candidate that satisfies research_verdict but fails current_release_gate_verdict is recorded as release_policy_review_required. It is not promoted to a release, and the release gate is not amended to accommodate it. The conflict is surfaced, not resolved here.

immutability.rule: Immutable once any experiment receipt cites this contract's digest. Policy changes create research-quality-v2.json; they never rewrite v1.
immutability.binding: Every experiment receipt records this file's SHA-256 as research_contract_sha256, alongside the existing experiment_contract_sha256 / quality_thresholds_sha256 envelope fields.
immutability.rationale: Declared before any candidate result exists. A threshold chosen after seeing a number is not a gate.

perceptual_metric.gating_source: scripts/benchmark/evidence_protocol.py render-scoring closure: torchvision_squeezenet1_1_imagenet1k_v1 backbone and lpips_v0.1_squeeze calibration, both SHA-256 pinned, network_access disabled
perceptual_metric.rule: LPIPS gates are evaluated with the repository's hash-locked SqueezeNet closure. It is provenance-bound and mechanically enforceable today.
perceptual_metric.vgg_rationale: The existing 26-run benchmark reports LPIPS(VGG), and published baselines use VGG, so it is recorded alongside for continuity and comparability. It does not gate until its weight lineage is closed under the project's clean-weight rule; hash-locking is not lineage.
perceptual_metric.independence_note: Gating on SqueezeNet while a candidate objective optimizes VGG features (as WD-R does) is a deliberate property, not an oversight: it prevents a change from being accepted by the same features it optimizes.

statistics.median_definition: Median over the 7 equally weighted per-scene deltas. Never a median over pooled per-view deltas, which would weight scenes by view count.

stochastic_replication.pairing: alternating fresh-process runs on a quiet host
stochastic_replication.replicate_unit: a whole training run; held-out views from one model are not independent samples

statistics.sd_definition: pooled repeat standard deviation across same-arm replicates

advance_to_consideration.note: A candidate that does not clear this is not evaluated further. LPIPS improvement alone never authorizes a metric trade; it only earns consideration. LPIPS(VGG) is recorded in the same receipt but does not gate.

perceptual_trade_acceptance.note: 0.4 dB is approximately a 9.6% MSE allowance. The human-preference requirement is what makes the trade substantive; without it this tier is unavailable.

per_view_veto_stochastic.outcome: hard veto, overrides any acceptance tier
per_view_veto_stochastic.note: Do not veto from a single noisy run. This is the criterion that correctly rejected clean-room fixed-cap MCMC, where four held-out views lost 1.06-1.82 dB outside baseline-repeat noise.

deterministic_rendering.applies_to: fixed-PLY renderer parity work (A1); no training, no run-to-run variance
deterministic_rendering.additional: no camera-turn regression against a freshly sorted reference

deterministic_probe.worst_cell_gate: worst radius / orientation / subpixel-phase cell, reported separately from the median

mathematical_correctness.outcome: passing permits a correctness claim only; it does not establish a quality gain, and a correct gradient that scores neutral is still correct
mathematical_correctness.coupling_rule: density-control thresholds stay frozen during each correction's A/B. A matched-checkpoint population shift of at least 10 percent, or a cull-reason shift beyond 4 baseline SD, triggers a separate density re-fit; it never changes thresholds in the same patch.
